questions.text: In Kiro Enterprise, what is a Kiro profile?

options.label: A collection of settings and controls that determines the Kiro experience for associated users or groups
An individual productivity report generated for each enterprise developer
An isolated self-hosted copy of the model running inside the company's VPC
A Spec template that replaces subscription tiers and credit allocation

questions.explanation: A Kiro profile groups settings and controls applied to associated users or groups. It is one of the enterprise administration concepts alongside IAM Identity Center, AWS region, groups, users, credits, and subscription tiers.

questions.text: Steering files in the repository (.kiro/steering/) are automatically shared with the entire team via version control.
questions.explanation: Steering files in .kiro/steering/ are part of the repository and shared with the entire team via Git, ensuring everyone follows the same development guidelines.

questions.text: A team of 20 developers needs to ensure everyone follows security standards when creating APIs. Which combination of Kiro features is most effective?

options.label: Versioned Steering with `inclusion: always` plus a `PreToolUse` Hook whose command blocks violations with exit code 2
A relevance-activated Skill plus a `PostToolUse` Hook, assuming exit code 2 reverts an already completed write
Steering with `inclusion: manual` plus a `Stop` Hook to prevent each write before it happens
An optional Custom Agent with no permission rules, selected only when a developer remembers

questions.explanation: `always` Steering keeps the rules in context; a `PreToolUse` Hook runs the policy before the write tool. For blocking triggers, the command can exit with code 2 to stop the action and return its reason to the agent.
